title: Adventures of Patch image sidecar provenance
description: Provenance metadata for images described by adventures.visual_sidecar.adjacent.v1 sidecars.

generator.description: The tool or service that generated or produced the image.

model.description: The model or engine used to generate the image.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp of generation if known; null if unknown.

prompt_language.description: Language of the prompt if known.

prompt.description: The exact prompt used to generate the image. Null or absent when the prompt was not retained.

prompt_retained.description: True if the exact prompt is preserved in this sidecar; false otherwise.

prompt_unretained_note.description: Human-readable explanation when the exact prompt was not retained.
